summary.name: Kimi API Model List
summary.one_liner: Kimi API Platform's model list page, covering currently available Kimi multimodal and coding models and migration guidance for discontinued ones like moonshot-v1 and kimi-k2.
use_cases: Check which Kimi API model is currently supported
Plan migration away from discontinued Kimi models
Find the retirement dates for kimi-k2 and moonshot-v1 models
Compare Kimi multimodal and coding model options
Identify the replacement model for deprecated Kimi endpoints
summary.what_it_does: The page lists Kimi API models, split into current multimodal and coding models and a Deprecated Models section. It states that kimi-k2.5 was discontinued on August 31, 2026, the moonshot-v1 series (including moonshot-v1-auto and the vision-preview variants) on August 31, 2026, the kimi-k2 series on May 25, 2026, kimi-latest on January 28, 2026, and kimi-thinking-preview on November 11, 2025. For each, it recommends kimi-k3.1-pro as the replacement. It also says K2 series models will stop being available to newly registered users from October 31, 2026, with all K2 models retired by the end of December 2026.
notable: Deprecation timeline with dated retirement notices for several Kimi models
Points users to kimi-k3.1-pro as the replacement for all listed discontinued models
K2 series retirement: no new registrations after October 31, 2026, full retirement by end of December 2026
caveats: Listed models like kimi-k2.5, moonshot-v1, kimi-k2, kimi-latest and kimi-thinking-preview are discontinued and no longer maintained or supported
K2 series models are being retired; existing users are not affected until the scheduled retirement
